purpose: Connect simultaneous events or two concurrent roles.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
V dictionary / N + と同時に; Nである + と同時に
The cat dashed out the instant the door opened.
She is both a doctor and a writer.
I began living alone upon graduating.
formation: V dictionary / N + と同時に; Nである + と同時に
restrictions: Can mean at the same instant or simultaneously in another capacity.
mistake: Do not assume every example describes one split-second event.
